name: Logitech USB Trackball
notes: 66-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech USB Trackball, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/-/project/147/uploads/3cead7f6a6425cc828fd7a8a7c888c20/libinput_record. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
